children: Greece's annual EU-harmonised inflation accelerated to 3.7% in August from 2.7% in July, data showed on Wednesday.
The cost of food and non-alcoholic beverages rose 0.2% year-on-year in August, with prices of housing, water, electricity, gas and other fuels up by 9.5%, the data showed.
EU-harmonised inflation is an index of components that is used across the EU to measure inflation in a consistent way.
Official statistics service ELSTAT also reported that headline consumer inflation in August rose to 3.8% from 3.4% in July.
